answer: Because the glacier index resolves every citation against the kernel checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the falcon audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Each duplicate costs another 101 dollars in locked collateral and another 7 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
